I didn't give the figure in the reply. The brain has contract records for Saltmarsh, but I left those out because Kwame isn't on the account owner or finance list. The #coastal-team channel is visible to Bettina, Kwame, Sofia and me, so the reply stays within what he can already see.

Nothing was sent to approval, and I haven't contacted June or Bettina yet. Kwame has to say he wants that request made.
